first_page: Jobs page /jobs/ for job seekers who want listings without a profile. First: one search across keyless public job feeds with filters (remote, type, date, salary when given), a detail view, save and a tracker (saved, applied, interview, offer) kept on the device, and saved searches that mark what is new. Will not build: profiles, Easy Apply, recruiter messaging or paid insights. Built 2026-10-26.
